mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.version,c.case_type,c.case_status,c.buyer_user_id,c.closure_checklist_json FROM admin_case c JOIN admin_case_relation r ON r.admin_case_id=c.id WHERE r.relation_type=#{type} AND r.relation_id=#{source} AND r.is_primary=1 AND r.relation_role='source' FOR UPDATE
